meta.subtitle: New Classmates · Interactive learning preview

dialogue: 老师
今天，我们有两个新同学，请他们介绍自己。
Today, we have two new classmates. Please introduce yourselves.
jīn tiān, wǒ men yǒu liǎng ge xīn tóng xué, qǐng tā men jiè shào zì jǐ.

data:image/png;base64,
友朋
大家好，我叫方友朋，今年八岁，我最喜欢跟爸爸一起游泳。
Hello everyone, my name is Fang Youpeng. I am eight years old. I like swimming with my dad the most.
dà jiā hǎo, wǒ jiào fāng yǒu péng, jīn nián bā suì, wǒ zuì xǐ huan gēn bà ba yì qǐ yóu yǒng.

data:image/webp;base64,
张莉
大家好，我叫张莉，今年七岁，我比较喜欢看书。
Hello everyone, my name is Zhang Li. I am seven years old. I quite like reading books.
dà jiā hǎo, wǒ jiào zhāng lì, jīn nián qī suì, wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan kàn shū.

data:image/webp;base64,
大文
你们好，我叫李大文。很高兴认识你们。
Hello, my name is Li Dawen. Nice to meet you.
nǐ men hǎo, wǒ jiào lǐ dà wén. hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ men.

data:image/webp;base64,
老师
欢迎你们来中文学校学中文。
Welcome to Chinese school to learn Chinese.
huān yíng nǐ men lái zhōng wén xué xiào xué zhōng wén.
